status: G5 first batch: processed, compressed and reviewed; ships as g5-debris-gothic, in Chapters I, II, III, IV, VII, VIII and X (on the web in Chapters II and III only)
use: The field after a victory: what a beaten Gothic band leaves beside its fallen, on the walked field.

generator.prompt: Battlefield debris of a beaten Gothic war band lying flat on the ground: three round wooden shields with iron bosses, one split in two, two broken spears with iron heads and a short axe, scattered over about two metres; nothing stands more than twenty centimetres high. Weathered painted wood, dark iron. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.

budget.note: Height set at review from 0.22 m: two of its shields came standing on their rims, about 0.6 m across, so 0.6 m keeps the spread at about 1.7 m. Bytes raised at review from 220,000 for its texture.

review.scope: Tripo's own render, four views of the final compressed model with a 1.8 m figure for scale (scripts/assets/preview-model.mjs), and the battles in the desktop build at High
review.notes: Five round shields with iron bosses, a spear and an axe. Two of the shields came standing on their rims against a spear, not lying flat as asked, so it was processed at 0.6 m high (not 0.22) to keep the shields about 0.6 m across and its spread 1.7 by 1.4 m. Accepted: on the walked field, seen from the camera's height, they read as shields propped where they fell.
